Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem with Stripe and other platforms is that they hold your money hostage. They freeze accounts without warning, and their payout delays can cripple your business. In contrast, NOWPayments is a decentralized infrastructure that puts you in control of your funds. With NOWPayments, you receive payments directly to your address, and you can withdraw your funds instantly. This means you're never stuck waiting for a platform to release your money. When platforms fail, NOWPayments keeps working, so you can keep selling and growing your business.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up a NOWPayments digital store, you'll need a few basic tools. First, you'll need a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account to host your store. Next, you'll need Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle the backend logic. Finally, you'll need a NOWPayments account to receive payments. Don't worry if you're not technical - NOWPayments has a user-friendly interface that makes it easy to set up and manage your store. With these tools, you're ready to deploy a NOWPayments digital store and start receiving crypto payments for your digital products.

The payment pipeline is the heart of your NOWPayments store. This is where you set up the rules for how you receive payments and deliver your digital products. To deliver your digital products, you can use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store and distribute your files. With NOWPayments, you can automate the entire process, so you can focus on creating and selling more products.
